title: On universal deformation rings and stable equivalences of Gorenstein-projective modules
summary: Let $\mathbf{k}$ be a field and let $Λ$ and $Γ$ finite dimensional $\mathbf{k}$-algebras. Assume that ${_Γ}X_Λ$ and ${_Λ}Y_Γ$ are bimodules that define a singular equivalence of Morita type with level (in the sense of Z. Wang) between $Λ$ and $Γ$ and which also induce an equivalence between the stable categories of finitely generated Gorenstein-projective modules $Λ$-$\underline{\text{Gproj}}$ and $Γ$-$\underline{\text{Gproj}}$.
